Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: HealthFlow wants a predictable inference stack for patient-facing summarization; key constraints are 50ms median latency for single-turn requests, SOC 2 evidence for audit, and an initial POC budget runway for 3 months.
- Short term goal: technical deep-dive + environment access to validate latency and KV-cache behavior on representative traffic.
- Success criteria for POC: < 100ms p95 at target throughput, ability to pin model versions, and a runbook for fallback to smaller models.

Suggested next step: 60–75 minute technical walkthrough with our solutions engineer to look at model variants, batching profiles, and network setup. Propose two windows (please pick one):
  • Tue Nov 9 — 10:00–11:15 AM ET
  • Fri Nov 12 — 1:00–2:15 PM ET

Please confirm who from your side should join (engineering, security/compliance, and network/infra contacts are most helpful). I attached a brief deck and a 1‑page MVP scope to help guide the walkthrough.

If you prefer a calendar invite right away I can send — do you prefer Google Meet or Zoom?

Thanks,
